title: Sculpture & Antiquity
description: Marble, bronze, and stone — the enduring forms of the ancient and classical world.

items.title: Commode à vantaux
items.medium: Oak, pine, walnut, mahogany, and cherry veneered with hornbeam (partially stained), tulipwood, walnut, holly and maple (both partially stained), boxwood, mahogany, and other woods; red brocatelle marble; gilt bronze; iron, steel, and brass
items.description_narrative: This Commode à vantaux, crafted by David Roentgen, showcases exquisite woodworking and intricate marquetry. Its construction features a luxurious combination of veneered woods, red brocatelle marble, and gilt bronze elements.
items.tags: furniture, commode, woodwork, marquetry, elegant, luxurious, 18th century, decorative arts

items.title: Sabine Houdon (1787–1836)
items.medium: White marble on gray marble socle
items.description_narrative: This white marble portrait captures Sabine Houdon, daughter of the acclaimed sculptor Jean Antoine Houdon. Created in 1788, it reflects the artist's masterful ability to render lifelike forms in stone.
items.tags: sculpture, portrait, marble, neoclassical, child, french art, 18th century

items.title: Damascus Room
items.medium: Wood (poplar) with gesso relief, gold and tin leaf, glazes and paint; wood (cypress, poplar, and mulberry), mother-of-pearl, marble and other stones, stucco with glass, plaster ceramic tiles, iron, brass
items.description_narrative: The Damascus Room is a lavishly decorated interior from an 18th-century Syrian home. Its surfaces are adorned with intricate gesso relief, gold leaf, mother-of-pearl, and painted details, creating an immersive and opulent setting.
items.tags: syrian, islamic, interior, architectural, decorated, opulent, 18th century, wood

items.title: The Death of Socrates
items.description_narrative: Jacques Louis David's monumental 1787 oil painting depicts the final moments of Socrates as he prepares to drink hemlock. Surrounded by his devoted students, Socrates remains stoic, pointing skyward in a gesture of philosophical defiance.
items.tags: socrates, classical, philosophy, death, neoclassicism, history painting, stoicism, sacrifice

items.title: Portrait of a Woman, Possibly a Nun of San Secondo; (verso) Scene in Grisaille
items.medium: Oil on wood; (verso: oil and gold on wood)
items.description_narrative: This intimate Renaissance oil painting on wood depicts a woman, possibly a nun of San Secondo, captured with delicate detail and quiet dignity. On its reverse, a monochromatic scene in grisaille, executed in oil and gold, adds another layer of artistic complexity to this early panel painting.
items.tags: renaissance, portrait, oil painting, italian art, religious art, panel painting, woman, grisaille

items.title: Portrait of Alvise Contarini(?); (verso) A Tethered Roebuck
items.medium: Oil on wood; verso: oil and gold on wood
items.description_narrative: This painting features a probable portrait of Alvise Contarini on the front, rendered in oil on wood. The reverse side reveals 'A Tethered Roebuck,' executed with oil and gold on wood, showcasing the dual nature of the artwork.
items.tags: portrait, renaissance, italian, oil painting, roebuck, contemplative, venetian, 15th century

items.title: Oedipus and the Sphinx
items.description_narrative: Gustave Moreau's seminal work dramatically captures the mythological confrontation between Oedipus and the Sphinx. This oil on canvas painting emphasizes the psychological tension and intricate detail, showcasing the artist's distinctive Symbolist approach to ancient themes.
items.tags: oedipus, sphinx, mythology, symbolism, french art, dramatic, psychological, confrontation

items.title: The Jabach Family
items.description_narrative: This grand portrait depicts the Jabach family, patrons of the arts, in a setting indicative of their wealth and intellectual pursuits. Charles Le Brun, a leading artist of his time, masterfully captures the family's presence and status through rich detail and classical composition.
items.tags: family portrait, baroque, french art, 17th century, oil painting, group portrait, aristocracy

items.title: Tommaso di Folco Portinari (1428–1501); Maria Portinari (Maria Maddalena Baroncelli, born 1456)
items.description_narrative: These oil portraits depict Tommaso di Folco Portinari and Maria Maddalena Baroncelli, meticulously rendered by Hans Memling. Created around 1470, these works exemplify the detailed portraiture of the period.
items.tags: portrait, oil painting, Northern Renaissance, 15th century, realism, Flemish art

items.title: Standing Figure with Jeweled Headdress
items.medium: Gypsum plaster; modeled, carved, polychrome-painted, gilded
items.description_narrative: This gypsum plaster sculpture depicts a standing figure adorned with a jeweled headdress, showcasing intricate modeling, carving, polychrome-painting, and gilding. Created between the 12th and early 13th centuries, this work is a testament to the artistry of its unknown maker.
items.tags: figure, sculpture, medieval, gypsum, jeweled, headdress, polychrome, gilded

items.title: Bronze figure of a boy in Eastern dress
items.description_narrative: This bronze figure depicts a young boy adorned in Eastern dress, showcasing the intricate details of his attire. It is a remarkable example of ancient metalwork from the Hellenistic or early Roman period.
items.tags: bronze, figure, boy, eastern dress, ancient, greek, roman, sculpture

items.title: Bronze statuette of a philosopher on a lamp stand
items.description_narrative: This bronze statuette depicts a philosopher, designed to adorn a lamp stand. Dating from the late 1st century BCE, it exemplifies Roman decorative arts.
items.tags: bronze, statuette, philosopher, lamp stand, roman, ancient, sculpture, decorative art

items.title: Marble torso of a boy
items.description_narrative: This marble torso depicts a young boy, possibly a deity or athlete, rendered with the refined skill characteristic of its era. Though the artist remains unknown, the work stands as a testament to the classical sculptural traditions of the Roman world.
items.tags: roman, sculpture, marble, torso, boy, ancient, classical

items.title: Limestone statue of Aphrodite holding winged Eros
items.description_narrative: This Cypriot limestone statue depicts the goddess Aphrodite cradling the winged figure of Eros. Dating to the late 4th century BCE, it reflects a common Hellenistic artistic theme.
items.tags: goddess, sculpture, ancient, cypriot, mythological, eros, aphrodite, classical

items.title: The Horse Fair
items.description_narrative: This monumental work by Rosa Bonheur depicts a bustling horse market in Paris, capturing the power and majesty of the animals with striking realism. Bonheur, known for her meticulous studies of anatomy, rendered each horse with extraordinary detail and dynamic energy.
items.tags: horses, realism, animal painting, French art, 19th century, large scale, plein air

items.title: The Fieschi Morgan Staurotheke
items.medium: Gilded silver, gold, enamel worked in cloisonné, and niello
items.description_narrative: The Fieschi Morgan Staurotheke is an exquisite Byzantine reliquary designed to hold a fragment of the True Cross. Crafted from gilded silver and gold, it features intricate cloisonné enamel and niello decoration, showcasing the skilled artistry of the early 9th century.
items.tags: byzantine, reliquary, gold, silver, enamel, christian, medieval, sacred art
